newsitem.title: USA: CBOT discusses scrapping evening pit session.
newsitem.headline: CBOT discusses scrapping evening pit session.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT) is discussing whether to discontinue its evening pit trading, which has been overshadowed by the growing use of the Project A electronic system, CBOT chairman Patrick Arbor said.
"I would hope that we resolve this question of whether or not to continue the evening session in the next couple of months," Arbor said at CBOT's annual meeting on Thursday.
He said there would probably be a membership vote on the issue, noting that members had held a vote when evening trading started. In the meantime, he said, the subject was open for discussion.
